notes.title: 2025.9.26 bugfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where some hospital doors could not collide.
- Fixed an issue where the number of ID cards picked up could exceed the upper limit.
- Fixed an issue where the crack in one of the hospital rooms disappeared.
- Fixed an issue where fingerprints were not visible on one side of the hospital's double doors.

notes.title: 2025.9.24 bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where some rooms on the second floor of the hospital had no footsteps. 
Fixed an issue where some characters could not be changed at certain resolutions.

notes.title: [Demo version update] Updated on April 2, 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[*] Refactored the code of the online room to solve some online-related problems, such as: evacuation was performed when not all players chose to evacuate.
[*] Added a new character model to facilitate 4-player online selection of different models to improve recognition.
[*] Added a button to reset the save file

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Fixed the problem that objects would frequently make collision sounds
[*] Fixed the problem that multiple runes would appear when the spirit is a demon
[*] Fixed the problem that the cross could not trap ghosts
[*] Deleted the collision box left in the magic circle
[*] Fixed the problem that the candlestick in the restaurant could not be picked up
[*] Fixed the problem that the pendulum glowed differently for each person

notes.title: [Demo version update] Updated on March 23, 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]

[*]Fixed the issue that when a plane is offline, other planes will be stuck and unable to pick up items and interact.
[*]Fixed the issue that when using a speaker, the sound wave will stay in place after switching items after it appears.
[*]Fixed the issue that when the player switches the props in his hand, the character will shake.

notes.title: [Demo version update] Updated on March 17, 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[*] When holding the tuner and adjusting the knob, switching items will cause the camera to lock.
[*] If you stick close to a ghost during the pre-hunt period, the ghost will always stand in front of you and you will not be able to hunt it successfully.
[*] When the spirit is a fog spirit, the passenger player sometimes cannot see the cracks created by the spirit stone.

notes.title: [Demo version update] Updated on March 13, 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo 1.3.14[/h1]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[*] Provide a skip button for the beginning of the tutorial.
[*] Optimized the process of the tutorial. You can learn more detailed exorcism processes by re-experiencing it.
[*] Optimized the layout to make it look less strange in English.
[*] Added a new operation option =》Crouching mode (hold/switch)

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Content adjustment[/h2]

[*] Changed the shooting conditions of the spirit photo. Now it will not be considered a successful shot when it is completely revealed. Now it can be shot as long as it is in the flashing stage.
[*] Added CD for the door, and the spirit will no longer play the door frequently.
[*] Added CD for hunting. Except for some special cases, there will be no seamless continuous hunting.
[*] Adjusted the logic of cold rooms to better distinguish them from low temperatures
[expand type=details expanded=false]
Old: Reduced from 20 degrees to -1 degrees based on the anger of the spirit
New: Reduced from 5 degrees to -5 degrees based on the anger of the spirit
[/expand]
[*] Adjusted the hunting logic of multiplayer gatherings so that it will not hunt as frequently. However, the hunting probability will be higher when 4 people gather.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[*] Fixed an issue where the spray sometimes could not be used
[*] Players outside the house are now invisible to the spirit, and the spirit will not block the door when seeing the players outside the house.
[*] Fixed an issue where the spirit would get stuck outside the house
[*] Fixed an issue where the spirit would sometimes hunt after being expelled
[*] Fixed an issue where the hand mirror could not be used to expel the dream shadow when participating in the game as a passenger plane
